step1_analysis.description: An NMOS differential pair extracted from a Noise-Shifting Differential Colpitts VCO. In the context of the paper, it likely serves as the active cross-coupled core or the current switching pair to sustain oscillation and lower phase noise.

Differential_Gain.description: Low-frequency differential voltage gain of the pair

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming 1mA tail current and 2kOhm load resistors: Id = 0.5mA per branch. gm = sqrt(2 * unCox * W/L * Id) = sqrt(2 * 270u * 10 * 0.5m) = 1.64 mA/V. Av = gm * Rload = 1.64m * 2k = 3.28 V/V = 10.3 dB
sky130_expected.reasoning: Gain depends heavily on the chosen load resistors and tail current in the testbench, which are set to standard values (2kOhm, 1mA) to verify basic functionality.

sky130_expected.calculation: BW = 1 / (2 * pi * Rload * Cload). With W=5u, Cload (parasitic Cgd + Cdb) is approx 10fF. BW = 1 / (2 * pi * 2k * 10fF) = 8 GHz
sky130_expected.reasoning: In this isolated testbench without the LC tank, the bandwidth is limited only by the RC time constant of the load resistor and the intrinsic parasitic capacitances of the NMOS drains.

Power_Dissipation.description: Total DC power consumption of the differential pair

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the 1mA ideal tail current source added in the testbench to bias the differential pair.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure differential gain, -3dB bandwidth, and power dissipation of the NMOS differential pair.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Differential Pair Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N3 LABEL_NET_0 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N2 LABEL_NET_1 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}

* Biasing and Loads
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
I_tail N1 0 1m
R1 VDD N3 2k
R2 VDD N2 2k

* Inputs (Common mode 0.9V, Differential AC 1V)
V_in1 LABEL_NET_0 0 dc 0.9 ac 0.5
V_in2 LABEL_NET_1 0 dc 0.9 ac -0.5

.control
* DC Operating Point & Power
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power
print v(N3) v(N2) v(N1)

* AC Analysis for Gain and Bandwidth
ac dec 100 1Meg 100G
let vout_diff = v(N3) - v(N2)
let gain_mag = mag(vout_diff)
let gain_db = 20 * log10(gain_mag)

meas ac midband_gain find gain_db at=1Meg
let gain_3db = midband_gain - 3
meas ac bw_3db when gain_db=gain_3db fall=1

quit
.endc
